prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE man standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, a man in his early 20s, swimmer physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, built like an elite swimmer. Enormously broad shoulders and wide lats forming a dramatic inverted triangle, a deep defined chest, a hard defined abdomen on a very narrow waist, long strong arms, and long straight muscular legs with narrow hips. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail jet-black hair — wearing nothing but a micro white leather mankini whose front pouch is a tiny opaque piece only two fingers wide and two fingers tall, with two straps as thin as a pencil lead rising over his shoulders and thread-thin side strings tied high at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest, stomach, hips and thighs otherwise fully bare. Pose: standing facing the camera, his right hand holding a tennis racket with its head resting on his right shoulder, his left hand resting on his hip — most extreme swimmer silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: extreme thick-soled derby shoes in dark leather, with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole, a natural relaxed stance with his weight settled on his feet.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past his fingertips, in glossy white leather with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on his chest, heavy gold rings on every finger, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. He wears a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a bronze hammer head, a tin square-sided cowbell, a silver barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body and ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine, beautiful woman's face with a soft rounded jaw, delicate features and long curled lashes, makeup: defined arched brows, plum and mauve eyeshadow blended into the crease, a sharp wing of liner, thick lashes, a rosy blush, deep berry-red satin lips

Background: a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE man only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of his head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside him at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
